Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The urine analysis shows significant leukocyturia, bacteriuria, nitrite positivity, and hematuria, with >100,000 CFU/mL E. coli cultured, indicating a urinary tract infection. The presence of glucose in urine is abnormal and may warrant further evaluation for glycosuria/diabetes. Low specific gravity suggests dilute urine. No casts or ketones detected. Recommend clinical correlation and appropriate antimicrobial therapy.
